sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Used to run the water collector
- Can be removed once installed to not be used if module doesn't need to be active.
- The filter lasts for 32 hours, 49 minutes, and 40 seconds.
  - The equation to convert water filter durability into minutes is 4.92 × durability.

sections.heading: Location
sections.text:
- Sport bag
- Toolbox
- Dead Scav
- Ground cache
- Buried barrel cache
- Technical supply crate

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: The filter is modeled on the Pentair Everpure Insurice 7SI.
